Opened on a Sunday, after a 3am start.

The Velvet Palm Studio celebrated its grand opening on Sunday 15 November 2026. The studio posted that same day: 3am grand opening prep, then grand opening day itself.

Until now the studio has lived only on Instagram, with no website and no links in its bio at all. This page gives it a proper home: the services, the room, the address, and one clear way to book a chair.

Services

What the studio does

Six services, exactly as the studio lists them. Keep scrolling and the rail travels with you.

Blondes

Dimensional blonde work, from soft and sunlit to bright and bold.

Cuts

Hair cuts built around your texture, your routine, and how the hair grows out.

Lived in color

Colour that grows out softly, so it looks as good in week eight as it did in week one.

Curly hair

Curls cut and cared for as curls, with their shape and bounce kept intact.

Extensions

Weft hair extensions for length and fullness that move like your own hair.

Braiding

Braiding with a steady hand and a clean finish, styled to last.

One more thing before the chairs. Colour here does not sit in bands. It melts.

Watch the colour melt

It starts at the root.

Deep, natural, and entirely yours. The melt begins where your own colour lives.

Then the colour pours.

One shade gives way to the next, root to tip, with no hard line where the work shows.

And lands in the light.

Lived in blonde, soft at every step. That is the whole idea of the chair you are booking.

Eclectic on purpose

Velvet chairs, palms in every corner, and mirrors full of Florida light.

The studio was introduced as a space for the bold, and the room keeps that promise. Warm wood, terracotta, and green everywhere, with the beach town sun doing half the decorating. It is a small room with a big personality, set up for one client at a time, by appointment.

Find it on North Dixie Highway in Lake Worth Beach, at Unit 208.

Stylists, the team is growing

In its latest post, on 24 November 2026, the studio announced it is recruiting stylists, in its own words: be your own boss, make your own hours, DM us to learn more.

A week after opening, the chairs are already multiplying. If that sounds like your kind of room, the studio would like to hear from you.
